_comment: MCP client configuration. Point your MCP-capable client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, the MCP Inspector, or the agent in ../mosaic_ai_agent) at this. The 'novabank-external' entry launches our custom server over stdio. The 'databricks-uc-functions' entry is a REMOTE managed server — replace <workspace-host> and use it directly from agent code (see ../mosaic_ai_agent/tools.py).

env._hint: Set DATABRICKS_HOST/DATABRICKS_TOKEN/DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH to query real tables; omit to use the local CSV fallback.
